text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle and I are on the way<n>home from an
outing when we decide<n>to stop by the shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What's that sign say, Trainer? "Rif"...<n>"Ruffle"?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It looks like there's a raffle going on.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with<n>our New Year's
raffle! This year's<n>grand-prize is a hot spring
vacation<n>for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot<n>hamburger
steak! Second-prize<n>winners get a bushel of
carrots! And<n>third-prize winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your<n>luck?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! So this is what a Japanese<n>raffle looks like!
I've been itchin' to<n>try one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's check it out, Trainer! We could<n>win ourselves
somethin' big!
choice_data_list: We have to buy something to get a raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I clean forgot about that part!<n>Let's see...
What should I buy?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I've got just the thing! I'm<n>gonna buy me
a jug o' milk!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...And so, we receive one raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We've only got one chance! Sure<n>seems like a long
shot...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I'm still gunnin' for the top prize!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! C'mooon, grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki pumps herself up and gives the<n>raffle spinner
an enthusiastic whirl.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the<n>spinner's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves<n>a grand-prize
winner! Come and get<n>the coupon for your hot
spring<n>vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! Now this has made my<n>day!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I did it, Trainer! So when are we<n>goin'?
choice_data_list: Y-you want to go with me?
Y-you want to go with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, of course! We're in this<n>together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When do ya wanna head out? Maybe<n>tomorrow—or
the day after that? Or<n>how 'bout right now?! 'Kay,
let's<n>pack our things and go!
choice_data_list: H-hold on! Let's save it for later!
H-hold on! Let's save it for later!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Later, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Are you sayin' I haven't<n>worked hard
enough to go to a hot<n>spring yet?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And it's a waste to go when you're<n>not tuckered
out? That's some true<n>Japanese spirit right there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I got ya! Let's go when the<n>time is right! It's
a promise!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It would be nice to use the trip as a<n>reward once
she reaches a<n>milestone...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I decide to hold on<n>to her ticket for
the time being.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize<n>winner!
Congratulations! You get one<n>deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But this big ol' hamburger steak does<n>look packed
full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Plus, huge slabs of meat<n>remind me of my
family back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we oughta take a picture so I can<n>show my
folks what I won!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Get over here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After that, Taiki Shuttle wolfs down<n>the deluxe
hamburger steak and fills<n>up with enough energy to
last into the<n>next day.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's<n>your lucky day!
You're going home<n>with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, we almost had it! Drat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But, these carrots are so shiny—they<n>look delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Since we got so many, what say we<n>invite
everybody in the dorm over for<n>a big ol' barbecue?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be a hoot! Let's go right<n>now and get
started!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That night, everyone thoroughly<n>enjoys themselves
at the<n>carrot-centric barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won<n>the third-prize!
Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww! Third-prize?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Urgh... That don't mean I gotta like it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here's what we're gonna do!<n>We're gonna
keep on shoppin' till<n>we get another ticket!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It won't be cheap, but I need that<n>grand-prize...
Heck, I'll even make do<n>with first or second!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I talk Taiki Shuttle out of her raffle<n>fervor and half
drag her back to the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you<n>pulled a blank one!
Take this pack of<n>tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oof... This raffle's pretty rough. I<n>guess life ain't all
sunshine and<n>rainbows, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So this is how my first raffle ends...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I join Taiki Shuttle in her<n>disappointment...
